name: Sensorium — The BCI Taste & Emotion Parlor
description: Sensorium operates out of converted Tier 3 commercial units, offering curated BCI-delivered sensory menus: archived flavors of extinct cuisines, spliced emotional composites from consenting donors, and synesthetic 'color-sound' journeys mapped by in-house neural artists. Sessions are conducted in individual recline suites with a licensed Sensory Technician monitoring feed integrity and preventing cascade overload. The flagship Chicago-North location became famous in 2209 for its 'Last Harvest' menu — reconstructed pre-Collapse seasonal eating experiences sourced from elderly donor memories.
story_hooks: A character purchases a synesthetic journey and recognizes, inside the experience, a memory that can only belong to someone they believed was dead.
The 'Last Harvest' archive donor turns out to have implanted a hidden message inside a taste memory — a confession meant for a specific person who would know how to find it.

A Sensorium location is quietly acquired by a Spire holding company that begins altering the donor archive, erasing certain cultural memory records that complicate a corponation's historical narrative.
